ItemID: NA; Title: The War Within; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Its melodic thrash sound fits my interest in Advance And Vanquish and the heavier In Flames albums.
ItemID: NA; Title: Mezmerize       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose its unusual rhythms and heavy hooks after spending time with Tool and Disturbed.
ItemID: NA; Title: Curse; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The melodic metalcore direction interests me, but Ascendancy gets my attention first this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Trapt       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It fits my interest in accessible hard rock like The Reason, though I want something heavier today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Ascendancy       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I would choose its mix of aggressive vocals, melody, and guitar work given my In Flames and 3 Inches of Blood listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: Vol. 3: The Subliminal Verses; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its heavy riffs and melodic passages appeal to the mood behind my recent Disturbed listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Crusade; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The thrash direction appeals to me, but I would try Ascendancy before choosing another Trivium album.
ItemID: NA; Title: Natural Selection; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its melodic hard rock fits my softer selections, but it is less compelling for my current heavier mood.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Lonely Position of Neutral; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The melodic alternative rock sound fits part of my history, though it would not be my pick today.
